text:
Alex P: Working on a microcharge timeline card for Console — shows per-tenant token burn, cache reclaim, and hotpath delta. Quick Q: do we surface cache savings as a negative cost line or as a separate 'credits' series? cc @Mira S @Derrick
Mira S: Prefer a separate credits series + a tooltip that explains reclaim policy. Negative cost lines confuse customers in billing views.
Derrick: Agree with Mira. Also question on attribution window for prefetch/pipeline cache — 1h rolling or session-based? Session based risks cross-tenant reassignments.
Jamie L: From analytics, 1h rolling window is more stable and matches our sampling. Session-based is noisy.
Alex P: Two follow-ups: 1) canonical metric names for FE/telemetry wiring, 2) quick SQL proto for hotpath delta so we can mock data.
Derrick: Suggested metric names: total_tokens, served_from_cache_tokens, cache_credits_applied, hotpath_delta_tokens. hotpath_delta_tokens = total_tokens - served_from_cache_tokens.
Alex P: SQL proto (very rough):
```
SELECT tenant_id,
  SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cache_hit THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS served_from_cache_tokens,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cache_hit THEN tokens * token_unit_price * discount_factor ELSE 0 END) AS cache_credits_applied,
  SUM(tokens) - SUM(CASE WHEN cache_hit THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS hotpath_delta_tokens
FROM request_events
WHERE ts >= NOW() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```
Mira S: Tooltip draft: "Cache credits = estimated token cost avoided by serving from cached responses or KV cache. Credits are for visibility only and do not affect invoicing unless you have a Reserved plan." Thoughts?
Jamie L: :thumbsup: tiny wording nit — replace 'cached responses or KV cache' with 'cached responses or KV/prefix cache' to be explicit.
CostBot: Heads-up: cost model updated in staging, prefetch/cache credits will be visible in the "Microcharge timeline (preview)" panel. No invoice impact.
Alex P: Great. I'll prototype the chart with a separate credits series + updated tooltip and share a screenshot tomorrow for quick UX + product review. Thanks everyone!
